title: Kagamine Rin — Share Your Memories〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Rin.
Here's an album from when I was in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, you really surprised me when you suddenly said you wanted to see pictures of me from back then...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hey, blame it on your story!
I wanna see what you looked like!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see... What grade was I in...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, here we are. This is a class picture from when we went on a field trip. See the girl in the front row, third from the right? That's me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's a small picture, so it might be hard to...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Ohhh!
That pouty face! It really is little you, Shih!!!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, is this from calligraphy class?! You look so focused! It's the same face you make when you're playing your bass!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <If I got a chance to meet you back then...!>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I'm practicing how to play this thing, but it's a little harder than I thought...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, why don't I help you figure it out☆

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: So, I'm stuck on this part.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, Shih! Just follow my lead!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm gonna play my keyboard, so you try to play along to my tune☆

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...! I played the whole thing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you did! So, Shih, chin up! Play like you just did and you'll be fine☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now, since you got the hang of it, let's try playing that one more time to really bake it into your mind!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Um, Rin...?
Thanks for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe...
I'd be like her big sister...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Rin, what in the world are you thinking about...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Okay, we can play it again!
I'm only doing this for you, Shih, because you're so precious♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I regret showing you this album.
